## What's Changed
* Your creature sits in your ship's cockpit, in a space suit by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/159
* Grass on green worlds' ground, close to it by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/153
* Galaxy map: a line from the ship to the star, and how far it is by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/162
* Terran worlds: mostly land, and flatter (ocean worlds' islands too) by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/163
* Animals panic when the ship flies close, and call to each other (#156) by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/164


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/compare/v2026.10.08.1...v2026.10.08.2

releases.body:
## What's Changed
* The low-orbit ship flies through trees, shaking them and knocking leaves off by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/131
* Smoke: check the rogue's disc is lit by the galaxy, not by its lava by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/135
* Terraforming phase 1: the climate model over time by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/133
* Low orbit: lava sea LOD, and the air and cloud sheet culled in patches by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/137
* Weather on gas giants, easy to spot: storms and night-side lightning by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/139
* Creature editor prototype: shape a spine, attach parts, paint, walk with IK by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/141
* Fewer draw calls near the ground, shaders compiled before planet zooms by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/145
* Spaceship editor prototype: build a ship from parts, paint it, take it for a test flight by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/142
* Build a planet over the zoom's first frames, not in one frame by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/147
* Zooming out of low orbit: no holes in the globe mid-crossfade by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/149
* Creature editor: Spore-style accessories, space outfits, and a skeleton that shows on hover by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/144
* Game animals: one generator, the creature editor's creatures, walking by its rules by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/148


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/compare/v2026.10.05.2...v2026.10.08.1

## What's Changed
* Ground rocks, shore swells, clear water, the ship's downwash, and smoking vents with sound on airless worlds by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/121
* Retake the water: tiled wave cascades and the light of real seas by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/125
* The ship's downwash on lava seas by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/124
* Lava seas that look like real lava lakes up close by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/127
* Release notes scroll on phones by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/126
* Ice worlds that look like ice: snow, blue glacier ice, sea-ice floes, Europa's lineae by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/128
* The low-orbit ship flies over trees instead of through them by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/129
* add volcano sounds by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/122
* Debug third-person view: watch the game camera's culling from outside by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/130


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/compare/v2026.10.04.2...v2026.10.05.1

## What's Changed
* Plant lab: the grove is a whole planet you can rotate around by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/99
* Force full screen on phones and tablets by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/107
* Craters on barren worlds (#98) by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/109
* Soft terrain: smooth shading instead of flat facets by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/106
* Galaxy arms with depth (puffy gas and haze) and a brighter core by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/103
* LOD for volcanoes in low orbit (#100) by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/104
* Release notes in the game's menu (#111) by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/112
* Roadmap: ground clutter ideas besides plants and animals by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/113
* Procedurally generated animals and the animal lab (step 35) by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/114
* Waves on the low-orbit sea, with shallows, surf, storms and whitecaps (#88) by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/115
* Species tab on the planet map, and a radar switch that tracks an animal species by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/117
* Star lab: edit and randomise stars, roll and tune their systems (#74) by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/101
* Stop Shift+press on the game from dragging the page by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/118
* Debug dumps in the planet and plant labs by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/102
* Abduct animals, and a laser that kills animals and plants (step 37) by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/119


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/compare/v2026.10.03.3...v2026.10.04.1

* Volcano bomb: a second weapon that raises erupting volcanoes by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/91

* Refine and cull the low-orbit sea like the ground; coarser gas giants by @elmaxe in https://github.com/elmaxe/sporer/pull/93
